bio_am: Ծնած է Կամախի Բագառիճ գիւղը՝ 1896-ին։ Թալէաթի ահաբեկիչը, մահացած է 1960-ին։
bio_en: Soghomon Tehlirian was born on 2 April 1896 (Old Style) in Lower Pakarij in the Kamakh district, the youngest of the sons of Khachatur and Hnazand; his father worked abroad in Serbia and was jailed in Trabzon in 1905 for having once left on a Russian ship. He studied at the Protestant and then the Yeznikian schools in Erzincan until 1911, and in autumn 1913 left for Serbia intending to study in Germany. The Tehlirian clan of about 85 people in Erzincan and Pakarij was destroyed in 1915. He became the symbol of 'just retribution' by killing Talaat, organiser of the Genocide, in Berlin in 1921; he later had two sons, Zaven and Shahen, with his wife Anahit, and died in 1960.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Talaat's killing (Berlin, 15 March 1921) is the subject of #484 ('How Talaat was killed'); the date itself not read in the portions seen. Poem #13 is dedicated to him.
